newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Value of NZ building work rose in Sept qtr.
newsitem.headline: Value of NZ building work rose in Sept qtr.

text.p: Building activity is continuing to rise, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
Most of the increase could be attributed to non-residential building work, which continued to show solid growth.
Residential building work was showing signs of approaching a plateau, SNZ said.
The trend estimate for all building work put in place rose 1.1 percent from June 1996 quarter to the September quarter.
The actual value of work put in place over the September quarter was NZ$1.77 billion, up 10.8 percent over the September 1995 quarter.
The cumulative value of work for the September year was worth NZ$6.7 billion, up 8.8 percent over the September 1995 year, SNZ said. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
